sheets.name: Test Cases
rows: Register valid synthetic staff details; verify through controlled email; inspect pending state.
Valid request saved once; verification and pending-approval states follow approved lifecycle; no premature privileged access.
Repeat registration with existing email; separately omit required field and use invalid email/college.
Clear validation; no unintended duplicate account or partial privileged account.
Admin approves one request and rejects another; attempt login for approved, pending and rejected users.
Access follows the approved state rules; state persists after reload.
Login with valid password, wrong password, then sign out and replay protected request; also test expired session.
Valid login works; wrong/expired/signed-out sessions cannot use protected resources.
Request reset to controlled mailbox; use valid reset once, then invalid/expired/reused token; try old/new passwords.
Approved reset lifecycle enforced; valid reset changes credential; invalid tokens fail without exposing secrets.
Request protected staff pages and APIs without session; request admin mutation as instructor.
Server denies unauthorized operation; no data or state change. Public exceptions require documented scope.
Instructor A reads, edits, uploads to and archives Class B by changing class/instructor identifiers in requests.
Cross-owner access denied for every operation; Class B unchanged.
With Student A context, substitute Student B identifier in dashboard/profile requests; repeat without valid student identity proof.
Access/change follows approved identity policy; Student B's private information is not exposed or changed.
Create Class A with valid required fields; separately omit required values; reload instructor list.
Correct class appears for correct owner; invalid creation fails clearly.
Archive then restore a synthetic class; inspect active/archived lists and associated enrollments after each step.
Lifecycle and related records match approved archive rules; no loss or duplicate enrollments.
Upload valid five-student classlist using supported template; reconcile every identity and displayed total.
Correct five records mapped once; preview/persisted values agree with source.
Upload valid gradesheet and attendance for known roster; compare selected source cells to stored/displayed values.
Correct student/term/field mapping with no shift, unintended overwrite or missing rows.
Upload file with mismatched student ID/name; separately repeat upload and introduce duplicate row.
Approved reject/update policy enforced; no cross-student writes or unintended duplicate record; partial handling reported clearly.
Upload empty file, malformed supported file and unsupported MIME type in isolated setup.
Rejected clearly without crash or unintended data changes.
Test file sizes at and just above 10 MiB; where endpoint supports multiple files, test aggregate at/above 50 MiB. Ensure fixture is otherwise valid.
Reviewed class-router limits allow boundary size validation and reject above-limit requests; record parsing errors separately from size checks. Other endpoints verified against their own rules.
Import known midterm/final/component and previous-term values; inspect respective views and calculate approved derived totals independently.
Terms/components remain distinct; calculations and rounding match approved formulas.
Enter/import missing grade, zero sentinel if applicable, allowed extremes and invalid values; reload.
Missing/out-of-range values handled explicitly; no false valid grade, corruption or silent interpretation.
Use approved session-count fixture (e.g. 8 present of 10 when this is the chosen formula); test 0%, 100%, missing and above 100%.
Expected 80% for simple fixture; approved attendance rules applied; zero valid and missing distinct; invalid range handled.
Use separate eligible synthetic records for whole midterm 2.49, 2.50 and 5.00; use 5.01 only as an invalid-input test. Trigger supported save/upload flow.
Under reviewed threshold, 2.49 does not trigger this grade-based reason; 2.50/5.00 do; 5.01 rejected or not treated as valid trigger. Other approved reasons assessed independently.
Hold whole midterm below referral threshold while varying CS/LAB/MO components; then change whole midterm to threshold.
Grade-based automatic referral follows whole midterm rule, not an individual component; confirm against approved policy.
Repeat eligible upload/update; view AMU referral, class/student/reason and assigned staff scope.
Correct linked referral and permitted AMU visibility; no unintended duplicate or misrouting.
Create invitation for Student A; open valid link; answer every required field; submit; inspect AMU record.
Correct form/student; answers persist and are linked to Student A; success shown.
Leave required field empty; separately answer valid boolean question false/no and complete other required fields.
Missing answer rejected; legitimate false/no not mistaken for missing.
Open random invalid token; test expired and reused token where defined by approved lifecycle; check no other student's answers exposed.
Invalid access denied; expiry/reuse policy enforced without data leakage.
AMU predict with complete fixture; separately remove midterm, attendance, and genuine assessment answers.
Complete fixture can proceed; each missing-source case returns insufficient data and no prediction; model not invoked for incomplete cases.
Set attendance to 0 with valid midterm and complete genuine assessment containing false answers; separately leave only derived assessment scores.
Valid zero/false data accepted as present; derived scores alone do not count as completed assessment.
Record artifact/profile/feature order; repeat fixed complete input; compare API and UI result, label, probability scale and model source.
Stable result for fixed version/input; class mapping and percent scale correct; displayed explanation matches actual inputs; no promised label based solely on referral threshold.
In isolated config remove model availability and restart/clear cache as required; predict complete fixture; compare instructor and AMU entry-point prerequisites.
Fallback/unavailability handled according to approved requirements; provenance not represented as trained-model output; prerequisite differences documented and resolved.
Save support-routing action for Student A referral; reload and inspect Student B referral.
Correct action persists only for intended referral/student; required details validated.
Send invitation/notice to controlled recipient; inspect receipt or test sink; simulate configured delivery/queue failure.
Correct recipient/content/link; queued and delivered states distinguished; failure is observable and retry policy does not cause unintended duplicates.
Login Student A, complete required profile if prompted, open dashboard and compare known data.
Correct own profile/academic/referral information; no Student B information.
Update allowed profile field; reload; submit invalid value and attempt another student's identifier.
Valid own update persists; invalid/unauthorized update rejected.
Admin approve/decline requests, archive/restore a synthetic user; test resulting account access.
Correct state changes and account access; non-admin cannot perform same mutations.
Edit assessment form; generate new invitation; open older invitation; inspect intended activity log.
New/old forms follow approved versioning behavior; intended audit entry has correct actor/action/time without secrets.
With known fixture totals, open instructor/AMU/admin dashboards; apply search and filters, including empty result.
Counts and scope match independently calculated records; correct handling of empty state.
Export available report formats; compare rows/counts/filters; open output with long names and multi-page data.
Correct authorized scope/content, readable headings/page layout and no clipped critical information.
Another member follows upload -> referral -> assessment task without coaching; record confusion and errors.
Task can be completed with understandable feedback; observations recorded, not fabricated user satisfaction scores.
Navigate key forms with keyboard; check focus/error labels, narrow/mobile and desktop viewports, loading/network-error states.
Important controls reachable and legible; no hidden required actions; clear progress and recoverable errors.
Record environment, 100 synthetic students, cold/warm conditions; time 20 dashboard/search/prediction runs using browser/network tools.
Results compared with agreed targets; median/p95, failures and limitations documented.
On recorded build: roster -> grades/attendance -> threshold referral -> assessment -> prediction -> routing -> report; rerun affected cases for every fix.
Correct identities/data through all stages; original defects retested; no affected regression failure; remaining blockers documented.
sheets.note: Prepared procedures. Actual result, tester, date, build and evidence are completed after execution. Sources: AEWS source review and activity guidelines.

sheets.name: Bugs
sheets.note: No defects have been asserted. Add one row per observed defect. Leave unused rows blank. Record fixes and retest evidence before marking Verified.
